add.title: LGBTQ rights in Washington (state) - Prison section (en.wikipedia.org)
add.published: 2026-09-19 (revision 1375707468; section reports events of Oct 2023 and Jul 2024)
add.summary: Prison section: in October 2023, Washington state prisons (under court order and rulings) were legally required to provide gender-affirming healthcare and/or sexual-reassignment surgery to inmates; in July 2024, a trans woman prisoner was transferred from a women's prison back to a men's prison as punishment for consensual sex with a cisgender inmate of the women's prison. Placement outcome documented: birth-sex (men's) housing used as sanction in 2024.
